purpose: Teach: 六本木/しみじみ/芸人/クーラー/日焼け/コップ/数える/茶色

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、本気で、絶対、六本木、絶対、行ったの?本気で
lines.en: Riku — did you seriously actually go to Roppongi?
lines.style: Direct, testing tone. Quick attack on his name. Genuine curiosity mixed with skepticism — she wants to hear the story. Leans forward slightly.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、本気で、絶対、しみじみ、絶対、思うけど、青春って、絶対、いいぜ、桜
lines.en: You know what? Youth really is amazing, Sakura.
lines.style: Slow, almost musing. Soft opening. Genuinely reflective — not performing depth. Like he's surprised by his own realization. Warm but a little distant.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: お前、本気で、絶対、お気に入りの、絶対、芸人、絶対、誰なの?リク
lines.en: So who's your actual favorite comedian, Riku?
lines.style: Playful pressing. Quick pace. She's testing him — genuinely curious but also enjoying making him answer. Slight tease underneath.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 教室の、本気で、絶対、クーラー、絶対、壊れたぜ、桜
lines.en: The AC in our classroom broke today.
lines.style: Dry, understated delivery. Matter-of-fact opening. Like he's switching topics with wry acceptance of the randomness. Small smile in the voice.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、本気で、絶対、部活で、絶対、日焼け、絶対、すごいね
lines.en: You got pretty sunburned from club, huh?
lines.style: Light, observational. Warm noticing — not mocking. Like she's commenting on something she finds endearing about him. Gentle tease.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前の、本気で、絶対、コップ、絶対、可愛いな、桜
lines.en: That cup of yours is actually kind of cute.
lines.style: Sincere but slightly embarrassed to be sincere. Soft, slowed opening. Like he almost didn't want to say it but did anyway. Trailing off gently.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、本気で、絶対、ファン、絶対、数える、絶対、と、絶対、お前、絶対、人気者だよね
lines.en: If you counted your fans, you'd realize you're pretty popular.
lines.style: Deliberate, playful rhythm. Building slightly as she makes her point. Teasing him but meaning it. Not letting him hide from the compliment.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前の、本気で、絶対、茶色、絶対、のバッグ、絶対、お洒落だな、桜
lines.en: That brown bag of yours — it's really stylish, Sakura.
lines.style: Soft, genuine compliment. Slower pace. Like he's noticed this detail about her for a while. Slightly vulnerable — noticing often reveals caring.
